ns2:section.sectionText: REGISTRATION IN THIS LECTURE REQUIRES SIMULTANEOUS REGISTRATION IN LAB AB1 OR AB2. Please note the stated prerequisites. If available, seats may open to sophomore majors at a later date. Watch the class schedule for updated information.
